notes:
Summary: Long evaluation with Cerulean (telemedicine triage + decision support). Primary blocker: cannot meet their p95 streaming latency SLO in private/VPC deployment. Security and latency together created an unblockable requirement. Lost to competitor that offered edge routing.

Key points / context:
- Use case: clinician-facing triage chat and real-time decision support at ER intake. Needs sub-350ms p95 for generation and near-instant token streaming for UI.
- Deployment: must live in customer VPC or fully on-prem (PHI). Head of infra insisted on HSM/KMS and strict audit trails.
- Expected ARR: $150k-$300k ARR; mid-market purchase. Deal had exec buy-in initially (VP Product + Head of AI).

Technical evaluation summary:
- Ran 2-week POC (dedicated pool in their VPC subnet) with ~120 concurrent users simulated.
- Observed p95 generation latency ~1.1-1.4s (tail spikes up to 2.8s) for 2k token average sessions - well above their <350ms p95 target.
- Streaming behavior: initial token came fast, but sustained streaming had jitter and second-token stalls (100-800ms jitter depending on sequence length). UI team reported noticeable 'hiccups' causing poor UX.
- Investigations performed: batching tuning, kv cache warm-up, model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model. Improvements reduced average latency but tail p95 remained >800ms.
- Root causes noted by infra: TLS termination inside VPC plus additional proxy hops (customer RBAC proxy) add ~90-180ms; their edge network had sporadic queuing under burst traffic; runtime-level streaming backpressure interaction with the proxy caused token emission jitter.
- Security: Cerulean's SecOps was uncomfortable with our VPC egress path for the managed control plane and requested HSM-backed signing for private model keys; final security review flagged missing HSM integration in our Private beta.

Customer behavior / timeline:
- 2025-11-21: Intro demo with VP Product + Head of AI. Good alignment on product fit.
- 2025-12-05: Technical deep-dive with Priya (SE) and infra team. Recorded (ff_2025-12-10_6682).
- 2025-12-10: POC kickoff - dedicated nodes in customer VPC. Baseline tests run.
- 2025-12-20: Interim sync - observed high tail latency; we shipped batching and RT tuning suggestions.
- 2026-01-08: Security review call - SecOps requests HSM/KMS + deeper audit logs (drive:/security/cerulean/security-faq.pdf).
- 2026-01-14: Last demo to execs comparing Redwood vs StreamlineAI (Streamline promised edge nodes). Fireflies ff_2026-01-14_3347.
- 2026-01-18: Cerulean signals vendor decision pending; internal champion (Head of AI) resigns.
- 2026-01-25: Procurement stalls due to hiring freeze and re-prioritization. No final PO.
- 2026-02-10: Received competitive win notification - selected StreamlineAI for lower p95 in their tests (edge routing + local FPGA nodes) and faster streaming stability.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "We need clinician-grade responsiveness; anything above ~350ms breaks workflow." - Head of Product
- "The jitter during streaming is a dealbreaker for our UI." - Frontend lead

Why we lost (short list):
- Couldn't consistently meet p95 SLO in their VPC/on-prem topology during POC.
- Streaming token jitter when proxied through customer's network and control plane.
- Security asked for HSM-backed key management; Private offering didn't fully meet their HSM needs at the time.
- Internal champion left; procurement deprioritized when budget tightened.
- Competitor provided edge routing + more mature streaming for on-prem use-case.

Next actions / recommended follow-up:
- Mark closed-lost; set 6-month reengagement cadence aligned to our Private HSM roadmap.
- Send competitive postmortem to product/infra teams (include observed traces and proxy timings - RED-3421 / RED-3567).
- Keep Cerulean on a low-touch nurture: quarterly product updates, highlight HSM and streaming runtime improvements.
- Opportunity to re-open if they pilot edge or accept hosted edge footprint.

Attached artifacts:
- POC logs & traces: RED-3421
- POC tuning notes: RED-3567
- Pricing/comparison deck: drive:/deals/cerulean/po-pricing-v2.pdf
- Security FAQ: drive:/security/cerulean/security-faq.pdf

Notes on engagement quality: high technical engagement early, but risk increased after champion departure. Legal/procurement never returned final terms due to hiring/budget freeze. Recommend flagging this kind of account for re-qualification after major infra or personnel changes.
